name: Super Crop Safe Limited
about: Super Crop Safe Limited manufactures and trades in agro chemicals, biological products, and pesticides formulations in India. The company offers technical grade pesticides, as well as insecticides, fungicides, and weedicides formulations. It markets its products through a distribution network. The company also exports its products. Super Crop Safe Limited was incorporated in 1987 and is based in Gandhinagar, India.
